```{r}
capture <- read.csv("Data/NWTMyotisCaptureRecords_ReimerBarclay2023.csv",
  na.strings = c("", " ")
)

library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(tidyverse)

# -------- LOAD CAPTURE DATA --------
capture_raw <- read.csv(
  "Data/NWTMyotisCaptureRecords_ReimerBarclay2023.csv",
  na.strings = c("", " ")
)


# Convert to proper types
capture_raw$Region <- as.factor(capture_raw$Region)
capture_raw$Sex <- as.factor(capture_raw$Sex)
capture_raw$Ageclass <- as.factor(capture_raw$Ageclass)
capture_raw$Reproductivestatus <- as.factor(capture_raw$Reproductivestatus)

# Remove NA in variables of interest
capture_clean <- capture_raw %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Region),
    !is.na(Sex),
    !is.na(Ageclass),
    !is.na(Reproductivestatus),
    !is.na(Forearmlengthmm),
    !is.na(Earlengthmm)
  )

# -------- REMOVE EAR LENGTH OUTLIERS (IQR method) --------
Q3 <- quantile(capture_clean$Earlengthmm, 0.75)
IQR_val <- IQR(capture_clean$Earlengthmm)

upper_bound <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_val

capture <- capture_clean %>%
  filter(Earlengthmm <= upper_bound)

# Convert categorical variables
capture$Region <- as.factor(capture$Region)
capture$Sex <- as.factor(capture$Sex)
capture$Ageclass <- as.factor(capture$Ageclass)
capture$Reproductivestatus <- as.factor(capture$Reproductivestatus)

#Change Names
capture_clean <-capture %>% 
rename(
    date = Night_date,
    lat = Latitude,
    lon = Longitude,
    region = Region,
    site = Site,
    band_id = BandID,
    species = Species,
    sex = Sex,
    ageclass = Ageclass,
    mass = Massg,
    forearm = Forearmlengthmm,
    ear = Earlengthmm,
    repro_status = Reproductivestatus,
    capture_time = Capturetime,
    release_time = Releasetime
  )

# Convert date
capture_clean$date <- as.Date(capture_clean$date, format = "%m/%d/%y")

# Convert numeric columns
capture_clean$lat <- as.numeric(capture_clean$lat)
capture_clean$lon <- as.numeric(capture_clean$lon)
capture_clean$mass <- as.numeric(capture_clean$mass)
capture_clean$forearm <- as.numeric(capture_clean$forearm)
capture_clean$ear <- as.numeric(capture_clean$ear)


# Remove rows missing coordinates
capture_clean <- capture_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon))

#Add a Season column for phenology

capture_clean <- capture_clean %>%
  mutate(
    month = as.numeric(format(date, "%m")),
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
      month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall"
    )
  )

# Save cleaned dataset
write.csv(capture_clean, "Data/capture_cleaned.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```



```{r}
acoustic <- read.csv("Data/NWTMyotisAcousticRecords_ReimerBarclay2023.csv")

#Make names into data
names(acoustic) <- make.names(names(acoustic))

# Rename columns
acoustic <- acoustic %>%
  rename(
    site = Site,
    lat = Lat,
    lon = Lon,
    date = night_date,
    myotis = Myotis,
    detector_active = Detector.Active,
    site_type = Site.type
  )

# Convert date (MM/DD/YYYY format)
acoustic$date <- as.Date(acoustic$date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")

# Convert Myotis to numeric
acoustic$myotis <- as.numeric(acoustic$myotis)

# Keep only active detector nights
acoustic_clean <- acoustic %>%
  filter(detector_active == "Yes")

# Replace missing counts with 0 (only for active nights)
acoustic_clean$myotis[is.na(acoustic_clean$myotis)] <- 0

# Create useful time columns 
acoustic_clean$year  <- format(acoustic_clean$date, "%Y")
acoustic_clean$month <- format(acoustic_clean$date, "%m")
acoustic_clean$doy   <- format(acoustic_clean$date, "%j")  # day of year

# Convert to numeric if needed
acoustic_clean$month <- as.numeric(acoustic_clean$month)
acoustic_clean$doy   <- as.numeric(acoustic_clean$doy)

#Add Seasonal Data
acoustic_clean<-acoustic_clean %>%   
mutate(
    month = as.numeric(format(date, "%m")),
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
      month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall"
    )
  )

# Save cleaned file
write.csv(acoustic_clean, "Data/acoustic_cleaned.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
